item.title: A look at Mississippi election facility as the race leans Democratic
item.description: The Senate midterm race in deep-red Mississippi is leaning toward Democrat Scott Colom as 99% of the vote is in. Colom is in the lead against Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith, but the clock is on to get those votes counted by Friday. Mark Strassmann reports, and Bruce Mehlman, a founding partner of Mehlman Consulting, has more details on midterm voting turnout.

item.title: The sinking of the SS United States, once the world's fastest ocean liner
item.description: The SS United States previously shattered records as the world's fastest ocean liner. Now, she'll break a new record, sinking off the coast of Florida to become the world's largest artificial reef. CBS News' Jared Ochacher shares the story of this historic American ship, from her glory days as a midcentury marvel to efforts to save her — and her future as an ecotourism site.

item.title: Full interview: Rep.-elect Nancy Lacore, former Navy Vice Admiral fired by Sec. Hegseth
item.description: Watch Margaret Brennan's full interview with Rep.-elect Nancy Lacore, a portion of which aired on Nov. 8. Rep.-elect Lacore will become the highest-ranking female U.S. military officer to ever serve in Congress. She served as chief of the Naval Reserve until she was let go by Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth without explanation in August 2025. Rep.-elect Lacore was one of more than three dozen candidates who flipped their seats in last week's "blue wave."
